notes_for_editor: Thin record, same pattern as Round Mountain: the FFLA Vermont list (type, status, coordinates) and an Eastern US Lookouts stub that reads Vermont - Essex County and Removed. No build date, height, staffing, fire history or site description was found. The brief's kind 'platform' is corrected to crowsnest per FFLA. Vermont has more than one peak called Sable Mountain (a search result showed one in Windsor County, not fetched), so keep the Essex County record; the brief's coordinates match the FFLA Essex County entry. The county list (source 4) is used only for context about neighbouring Essex County entries.
